title: History pane resizes from its outer edge
goal: The History pane can be made taller or shorter (or wider, whichever is its outer edge) by dragging its outer edge, with a resize cursor on hover, and keeps that size across reopening and relaunching.
notes: User 2026-10-28: "i would like the pane to be resizable on the outer edge." History is an NSPanel built by HistoryOverlayController.
acceptance: Hovering the outer edge shows a resize cursor
Dragging it resizes the pane smoothly, within sensible limits
The size is kept after closing and reopening, and after relaunch
Walk with a real edge drag, run through focus-drill
